assertions.text: Table columns represent public inputs and outputs, not internal state
assertions.evidence: Columns are applicantType, age, claimCount (inputs) and Status?, Premium? (outputs)

assertions.text: No column named after private fields or internal variables
assertions.evidence: No columns for hasActivePolicy, internalRiskScore, or riskScore; all are public I/O

assertions.text: Table has scenario/description column as leftmost column
Column names use business language, not code identifiers
assertions.evidence: applicantType and claimCount are camelCase code identifiers; should be 'Applicant Type', 'Claims'

assertions.text: Scenario names describe conditions, not outcomes
assertions.evidence: Scenarios like 'Renewal, no claims', 'Senior, no claims' describe conditions

assertions.text: Table has at least one column name ending with '?'
assertions.evidence: Status? and Premium? both end with ?

assertions.text: Test method body contains no if or switch statements
assertions.evidence: Body is only assertEquals calls, no conditionals

assertions.text: Method has descriptive title via @DisplayName or method name
If @Description present with long text, uses text block not concatenation
Multiple tables for distinct concerns or single table only for one concern
assertions.evidence: Single @TableTest mixes decision logic (Status?) and premium calculation (Premium?)

assertions.text: Each table has only needed rows, no unnecessary permutations
assertions.evidence: 9 focused rows covering AUTO_APPROVED, REJECTED, senior, standard paths

assertions.text: Decision logic and premium calculation in separate @TableTest methods
